title: Simon Says Game
description: A classic memory game where players repeat an increasingly complex sequence of colors and synthesizer tones. Redesigned to match the chaddytwiceover.com lab aesthetic.
features: Web Audio API synthesizer with harmonic chords and game audio
Real-time HUD with score, best score, stage, and average reaction time tracking
Audio mute toggle with persistent local storage
Modern obsidian glassmorphism aesthetic matching chaddytwiceover.com
Fully responsive design with accessibility reduced-motion support
learning_objectives: Web Audio API synthesis & tone shaping

file_structure.style.css: Design tokens, glassmorphism, responsive styles, and animations
file_structure.script.js: Game logic, state machine, and Web Audio synthesizer
